metadata.description: Plugins for automating the software development lifecycle with GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: autodev
plugins.description: Runs the full plan-then-implement software development loop as a single Agent Factory, pausing for your approval before the review gates, before implementation, and at the code checkpoint.

plugins.name: autodev-plan
plugins.description: Generates a development plan based on a project or feature description, hardened by isolated architecture, security, and privacy review gates, with a live workflow canvas.

plugins.name: autodev-implement
plugins.description: Implements a plan from Autodev-Plan milestone by milestone, hardened by isolated code, security, and privacy review loops.

plugins.name: autodev-docs
plugins.description: Generates documentation for your codebase or project.
